meta.description: Modern veterinary care built around prevention, quiet observation and calm handling. Studio-standard diagnostics, surgery and dentistry for dogs, cats and small companions.

items.v: Weight, appetite, water, sleep, gait. Most findings start as a small change at home.
Quiet handling, unhurried time, and a clinician who explains what they are checking.
A written summary, a plan you can follow, and reminders for what comes next.

about.title: We watch carefully.
about.intro1: {clinic} is built around one idea: animals rarely announce what is wrong. They change small things — appetite, water, sleep, gait — and the people who live with them notice first.
about.intro2: So we start by listening to what you have seen, and we take the time to explain what we are checking and why.

principles.v: The least dramatic part of veterinary medicine is the most useful. Vaccination, parasite control, weight and dental care prevent far more than they treat.
We ask about appetite, water, sleep and behaviour before we reach for anything else. Your description is clinical information.
You should leave understanding what was checked, what was found, and what happens next — in plain language.
If nothing needs doing, we say so. Trust lasts longer than a transaction.

about.teamTitle: The people who will actually be in the room.
about.teamNote: Clinician names, portraits, roles and availability are placeholders. Nothing here should be read as a published credential.
about.clinicBody1: Separate waiting areas for dogs and cats, non-slip surfaces, and rooms large enough that nobody has to be pinned to a table to be examined.
about.clinicBody2: In-house laboratory, digital radiology, ultrasound, and a surgical theatre with continuous anaesthesia monitoring.
about.whyBody: Because they cannot tell us. Because you noticed. Because a small change, caught early, is almost always simpler than the same change caught late.

care.intro: Ten kinds of visit, each with enough time booked to do it properly. Prices are placeholders until the clinic publishes its list.
care.notSureBody: Start booking and answer a few plain questions about what you have noticed. We will recommend the right kind of visit — no medical vocabulary required.

doctorsPage.intro: Four clinicians, four specialisms, one standard: explain what you are checking, and never rush the animal in front of you.
doctorsPage.note: Names and portraits are placeholders pending the confirmed practice team.

gallery.intro: Every portrait in this campaign is shot the same way: studio lighting, natural shadow, and nothing behind the animal but white. Consistency is the whole point.
gallery.hint: Tap any portrait to open it full size. Arrow keys move through the set.

journal.intro: General educational content, written to be useful — not to sell a treatment. Nothing here replaces an examination.
